suggested_changes.reasoning: To combat overfitting, increase the dropout rate to 0.5 and add weight decay to the optimizer. Reducing gamma to 2.0 will reduce the focus on hard examples, and increasing alpha to 0.8 will give more weight to the positive class. Increasing the number of epochs to 200 will provide the model more opportunity to learn from the imbalanced data, and increasing the patience for early stopping to 15 will allow the model to train for longer before stopping due to lack of improvement. Implement auto threshold optimization based on F1 to improve recall/precision balance.
